mapper.select: SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, A.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, A.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_DONG A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.SORT_ORDER)

SELECT A.LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.LINE_GBN AS LINE_GBN, A.START_FLOOR AS START_FLOOR, A.END_FLOOR AS END_FLOOR, A.HO_NO AS HO_NO, A.EL_CNT AS EL_CNT, A.ROOFTOP_CNT AS ROOFTOP_CNT, A.DOOR_CNT AS DOOR_CNT, A.HO_NM AS HO_NM, A.HO_SORT AS HO_SORT, B.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, B.LOWER_FLOOR AS LOWER_FLOOR, B.HIGHER_FLOOR AS HIGHER_FLOOR, CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(INT, A.END_FLOOR) + CONVERT(INT, A.EL_CNT) + CONVERT(INT, A.ROOFTOP_CNT)) AS FLOORS, B.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_LINE A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.LINE_NO)

SELECT A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ AS MINWON_AREAR_SEQ, A.AREAR_NAME AS AREAR_NAME, B.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, B.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON_AREAR A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND B.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.ORDER_SEQ), CONVERT(INT, A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ)

SELECT A.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, B.HO AS HO, B.HOUSE_SIZE AS HOUSE_SIZE, B.HOUSEHOLDER AS HOUSEHOLDER, B.HOUSE_PHON_NO AS HOUSE_PHON_NO, B.HP_NO AS HP_NO, B.LIVE_TYPE AS LIVE_TYPE FROM dbo.TMN_DONG A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG_HO B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} AND B.HO_ID = #{HO_ID}
